'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a mob drop, obtained by killing [[Monsters|blue slimes]], found only within the [[dungeon]]. It's primary use is to serve as an alchemical material, able to be broken down into reagents once studied, alongside [[honey]] and [[hemp]].

==Alchemy==
{{PAGENAME}} can be decomposed into [[acceleration solution|solution]] and [[acceleration extract|extract]] with the [[hand mixer]] and any of the distillation cubes, respectively. Having unlocked [[Anatomy and Alchemy (Tech Tree)|Master of Alchemy]] produces one additional reagent at any workstation.
